name: time-to-stable
description: Measure how long web platform features take to become stable across browsers, powered by MDN Browser Compat Data and WebDX web-features on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.predev: node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { if (!fs.existsSync('public/data/manifest.json')) process.exit(1); }).catch(() => process.exit(1))" || npm run build:data
